name: Checklist
summary: Checklists for a type of item and a role — merge requests as reviewer, issues, papers — plus lines for one item, shown for the item you pick, from your angle.
guidance: Work here is held to checklists somebody wrote — nothing is hardcoded, so read them. A checklist applies to types of item × roles (merge requests as reviewer, issues for any role, papers), and an item may have lines of its own. Call `checklists` with the item you work on (a ref like gh#105, or an epic for its paper) and no checklist id to get all that applies, with what is ticked there; pass `role`, or the person’s `my_roles` as the host’s read_tracker says them. Answers are per item: two issues keep separate ticks. Before calling anything done, answer each line or say plainly which you could not, and why. `check_item` answers under your own name: state passed (default), failed or na, plus a note. An answer a person set is theirs: say what you found in words. `add_item_for` adds a line just for one item; `hold_checklist` with types and roles makes a list apply. If none fits, `create_checklist` — but look first.

mcp.about: Checklists somebody wrote, and ticking one off against a specific issue, change or paper.
